note: 19 measured exhibit regions: 15 figure rows covering the printed numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 6-16 and 2 table rows covering Table 1 and Table 3. Every exhibit number the paper prints has a measured region, so no printed exhibit is missing: 15 figure numbers and 2 table numbers are printed and all 17 are measured. Figure 2 and Figure 12 each carry ONE printed number over two measured regions, so each is one row plus a fragment-of-other region; a figure would only become two rows if it printed two numbers. Figure 5 is never printed anywhere — neither as a caption nor in the prose — and Table 2 is never printed either; both are printing facts about this paper, not measurement loss, and no bbox is invented for them. Eighteen regions are excluded: the lower half of Figure 2 (p4r2) and the lower pair of Figure 12 (p18r2) as fragment-of-other, two full-page appendix rasters (p26), the summary-sheet header band (p1), a display formula and the Algorithm 1 listing (p11), an uncaptioned 71x78 pt graph sketch in the body margin (p11, in-body-diagram) and ten 693-path watermark blocks. The section of eight regions had to be read from the printed headings rather than taken from the layout pass, which assigns a figure to the heading printed below it (p3, p4, p5, p15, p23), to a stray cross-reference heading '1 Common Impacts' (p7) or to the watermark-suffixed label '7.4 Solution 数' (p21). Section numbering has holes that are printed facts: the titles of section 6 and section 7 are never printed, nor are 6.1, 6.4, 7.1 or 7.2, and the p21 exhibit therefore records the path '7.4 Solution' alone rather than invent a parent title. Three text-layer defects are visible in the records: the Figure 8 caption is glued into a body line ('... and the results Figure 8 Shortest path simulation') and is printed without a colon; the Figure 6 caption sits between watermark m-runs; and the Figure 16 caption is truncated as printed ('Sensitivity analysis of d'). The prose cites figure numbers only in the p1 abstract (Figures 6, 7, 9, 12, 13) and four times in the body (Figure 2 p4, Figure 4 p7, Figure 6 p12, Figure 9 p13); every other exhibit is introduced by words alone, which is why ten of the fifteen figure rows and the Table 3 row record a caption-only mention. Figure 12's caption is printed at y610 below the lower half and the layout pass detects no caption band for the upper half, so the position is read from the page. p25 yields no measured region at all and is not a gap: the page is one full-page raster of the 'MEMO — TO: Mayor of Baltimore' letter, tiled by the producer into 113 horizontal strips 7.2 pt tall, so every strip falls under the 25 pt minimum side and `page_regions` keeps none of them; the page image is an appendix letter, not a numbered exhibit. The two raster blocks of p26 are the same shape and are excluded as page images. The p26 page carries the running head 'Page 26 of 25' while p25 prints 'Page 25 of 25', so the appendix page number runs past the paper's own page total.
